parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL1122023. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122023'. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
